18.item: placido incessu (apparatus lucido — kept printed); matrona Christi, dei delicata
18.sense_relied_on: calm step, Christ's matron, God's darling

18.item: a sanguine ad sanguinem, ab obstetrice ad retiarium; baptismo secundo
18.sense_relied_on: from blood to blood, midwife to net-fighter, washed after bearing in a second baptism

18.item: Tu nos, te autem deus (gestu et nutu before Hilarianus)
18.sense_relied_on: thou us, but God thee — by gesture and nod
